power:1.how: WCH CH224 datasheet V2.0 (done.land mirror, fetched 2026-10-29): table 4-1 pin 8 VBUS 'needs to be shorted to VHV'; table 8.1.1 VIOHV (PG, VBUS) -0.5..32 V; reference schematic 6.1.1 ties VBUS to VHV. The 3.8 V in sect. 7.1 is in the CH224K-substitution notes and repeats the CFG1 figure: a copy error. Lite runs VBUS at 20 V (37 % under 32 V).

parts:15.how: Same as power:1: CH224 V2.0 table 4-1 and table 8.1.1 rate VBUS to 32 V; sect. 7.1's 3.8 V is a copy error in the CH224K-substitution notes.

power:4.how: CH224 V2.0 reference schematic 6.1.1 is this exact circuit: Rset on CFG1 with an MCU's I2C on CFG2/CFG3. Contingency on both boards: the I2C links are 0R (Lite R2/R3); depopulated, CFG2/CFG3 float on their internal pull-ups, which 6.1.1 names as the plain single-resistor case.

power:6.how: Fail-safe by direction: if PG never asserts or can't sink Q4's ~0.35 mA (2.6 V/10k base + VBUS/220k), PVDD simply stays off (no amp, no damage) and firmware reports it (GPIO4 reads PG, GPIO39 reads PVDD). Firmware also drops PVDD before any renegotiation (firmware-requirements L4). Rework: short Q4's emitter pad to the adjacent GND pour.

power:9.how: With R6 220k + C19 2.2 uF the turn-on peak is 5.8 W for a ~28 ms ramp (sim tb_lite_fw_on_20v_FIX), against the AOS AO4485 single-pulse SOA of about 25 W at 5 ms and 20 W at 10 ms that the power review read (POWER-2/4): >3x margin, so a clone with up to a third less SOA still passes. Steady state 5 A x 15 mohm = 0.38 W.

audio:3.how: R54 100k -> 10k: SDZ sits at 3.2 V - 50 uA x 10k = 2.7 V worst case (TI SLOS708G IIH max 50 uA) against VIH 2.0 V: 0.7 V margin.

digital:22.how: Everest ES8388 datasheet rev 5.0 (July 2018) sect. 5.2: 2-wire chip address 001000x, x = AD0 (the CE pin): 0x10 with CE (pin 26) on GND, as Lite wires it. Fetched 2026-10-29.

thermal:8.how: Margin holds even at hwde's pessimistic 47 C/W: 1.75 W at 1/8 power into 4 ohm gives Tj = 45 + 82 = 127 C, 23 K under the 150 C trip (reviewer's own estimate 94-106 C). Above that, the firmware governor (firmware-requirements L1) and the chip's own latched OTP with FAULTZ recovery (L2) protect it: the failure mode is a mute, not damage. Bring-up measures the case temperature at 1/8 power.

dfm:9.how: Lite J1 HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 (C165948): footprint from EasyEDA (lib_pull 2026-10-29), its VBUS/GND pads redrawn as plain 0.6 x 1.3 mm rectangles (EasyEDA's 0.1 mm stroke left a 0.1 mm VBUS-GND gap) and its signal pads trimmed to 1.13 mm at the tail end (the USB4105's inner edge); shell legs 0.8 mm slots as HRO draws them. CPL: hwde cpl_verify against the LCSC model passes in the dfm gate (2026-10-29), no offset warning.

audio:20.how: TI SLASEE9C (rev. May 2025) section 5 and the pin table: the DDV PowerPAD is on the top side, 'connect to grounded heatsink'; RthJA 44.8 C/W without one (DFM-3, THERMAL-1). The 'pad on bottom' feature bullet contradicts the drawing and pin table. Handled by the lid-pressed heatsink (docs/review-2/dispositions.json THERMAL-1).

parts:23.how: Resolved (task 261029-075354, issue #47): U15/U16 are now the pin-identical pad-down TPA3220DDW (C2879306; TI SLASEN3B table 5 'TPA3221 ... Top ... Y'). Its EP is soldered to GND on a 7.3 x 4.43 mm land with 15 x 0.3 mm vias into In1/B.Cu, so nothing is fitted by hand. On-board RthJA is about 26 C/W (JEDEC 23.5), so 1/8 power into 8 ohm runs at Tj about 84 C. Into 4 ohm, the C2 governor holds the chip near 2.5 W (16 W in, 60 s). LCSC stock is 0, so it is bought into the JLC inventory from Mouser/DigiKey (fab/prebuy.csv). See docs/review-2/heatsink-options.md.

audio:29.how: Firmware's (C7): the register set is written over I2C after boot and can be changed by OTA; the hardware (I2S at 49.152 MHz MCLK, 1.7 % under the limit) fits ESS's documented modes.

audio:32.how: PCM5102A DIN is a plain high-impedance CMOS input (TI SLAS859 pin table: no internal pull); with its +-10 uA max leakage against the ESP32's ~45k IO12 pull-down at reset, IO12 sits at <=0.45 V, under VIL 0.825 V: the strap reads low (3.3 V flash).

audio:34.how: ES7243E BCLK-as-MCLK (register 0x02 bit 7) is set by firmware (C10). If it didn't work, only the line-in/self-measurement ADC would be lost; streaming to the DAC and amps doesn't use it. Bring-up checks the ADC first thing.

audio:37.how: Parts review (docs/review-2/parts.md, 2026-10-29): every SOT-23 transistor checked datasheet pin -> symbol -> pad; S8050 (C2146) B=1, E=2, C=3 matches.

digital:2.how: R45 is now 2.2k: OE stays under 30 % VDD (0.99 V) against any internal OE pull-up of 5.1k or more (oscillator OE pull-ups are typically ~100k); the TCA9539 that drives it has no pull-up and resets with EN. Bring-up scopes IO0 at EN rise.

thermal:3.how: Moot: there is no heatsink since the TPA3220 swap (task 261029-075354). The board's ~26 C/W is the figure, and bring-up C3 measures it. OTW (P11), FAULT (P10) and the ISENSE governor (C2) still bound a hot amp.

thermal:4.how: Covered by the same OTW/governor backstop (thermal:3); the governor limit (30 W in per chip) holds chip loss to ~3 W whatever the split.

thermal:11.how: The Plus/Ultra enclosure is designed (enclosure/, vents over and under each amp). With the TPA3220 the board sheds the amps' heat into that air. 45 C box air is the design case, and bring-up C3 measures it. The OTW/governor backstop applies.

Its EP is soldered to GND on a 7.3 x 4.43 mm land with 15 x 0.3 mm vias into In1/B.Cu, so nothing is fitted by hand. dfm:0.how: Pins 1/3 are now 1.6 x 2.4 mm plated slots centred between the two readings of the drawing (0.28 mm to spare at the pin corners either way), legs 2.0 x 3.0 as drawn, on both boards.

dfm:34.how: hwde dfm gate's cpl_verify against each part's LCSC/EasyEDA model passes on both boards after the swaps (2026-10-29): Lite J1 C165948, U6 C81010; core J1 C7095263, U8 C81010, U17 C131972, U18 C42421366, Y1 C7431354.

dfm:16.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000262/263 Rev.1 (everlighteurope.com, fetched 2026-10-30) p5 (third-angle views: the top view above, the port at the left of the right view): the posts are 5.88 from the port face, then 2.61 to the NC row and 2.63 to the signal row. On core U19 (rot 180) the port faces the top edge (the rear panel), the post holes and NC row sit between it and the signal row, and the port face lands at y 121.397, 0.70 mm inside the edge, as enclosure/core.board.json has it.

parts:51.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000262/263 Rev.1 (everlighteurope.com, fetched 2026-10-30) p5 bottom view, port at the top: 3-2-1 left to right, so facing the port pin 1 (Vout) is on the right. On the board, port up, that is the left-hand pad (x 137.447), footprint pad 3 = /OPT_SPDIF; the right-hand pad (x 142.527), footprint pad 1 = OPT_VCC, sits under Everlight pin 3 (Vcc). The symbol's numbering is the reverse of Everlight's, and so is the footprint's: the copper is right.

parts:52.how: The library footprint had the T8BK's two 1.70 mm post holes, but the routed board still carried the old T10BK copy without them (0 NPTH on U19 in core.kicad_pcb). kicad/gen/u19_posts.py (2026-10-30) adds them as NPTH 1.70 at (+-2.80, +3.92) per Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000262/263 Rev.1 (everlighteurope.com, fetched 2026-10-30) p5, moves the GND via that sat in one, and refills the zones; DRC 0. The front offset is the T8BK's: 5.88 from the posts puts the port face at local +9.80, the courtyard's edge, and enclosure/core.board.json already places it there.

parts:64.how: boards/ultra-front (on main 2026-10-30) has the same FPC-05F-20PH20 (C2856803) as its J1, at rotation 0, pin N on the same signal as core J3 pin N (checked pad by pad in both .kicad_pcb). In the Ultra box J3 (core x 20) and J1 (front-board X 14 + 6) line up, and the cable leaves J3 forward, turns down, runs forward under the front board and up into J1: three bends about the same axis keep the conductor order and turn the contact face from J3's side to the side away from J1's contacts. With the same part at both ends that holds whichever side the part's contacts are on, so the cable is a 20-pin 0.5 mm type B (opposite-side contacts), pin N to pin N, as enclosure/README.md and boards/ultra-front/README.md say.

dfm:2.how: True of the TPA3221, which the board no longer uses. U15/U16 are the TPA3220DDW, with the pad on the bottom (SLASEN3B pin table: 'PowerPad ... Placed on bottom side of device'). It is soldered to GND with no heatsink (task 261029-075354).

thermal:0.how: True of the TPA3221 (SLASEE9C sec 5). The board now carries the TPA3220DDW (C2879306), whose pad is on the bottom (SLASEN3B sec 6, pin table), so the top-slug problem is gone (task 261029-075354).

parts:22.how: The TPA3220DDW footprint keeps the same 44 pads (1.6 x 0.4 mm, rows 7.6 mm, 0.635 mm pitch). It adds pad 45, a 7.3 x 4.43 mm EP, which matches TI's DDW0044D land (SLASEN3B p42 example board layout), with 15 x 0.3 mm vias and 63 % paste in 4 windows (task 261029-075354).

power:10.how: Lite D1 is now SMBJ22A (BORN, LCSC C151920; 2026-10-30): BORN SMBJ series datasheet (datasheet.lcsc.com, productCode=C151920) electrical table row SMBJ22A: VRWM 22 V, VBR 24.4-26.9 V @ 1 mA, Vc 35.5 V @ 16.9 A, IR 1 uA @ VRWM. PD 20 V +5 % = 21 V sits 1 V under VRWM. Core D1 SMBJ30A unchanged (MDD table, VBR 33.3-36.8 V, Vc 48.4 V).

thermal:30.how: Fixed in the design 2026-10-30: D1 SMBJ22A (VRWM 22 V), so the 21 V worst-case rail is below standoff and IR <= 1 uA at 25 C (BORN table); the SMBJ20A's above-VRWM leakage question no longer arises.

parts:45.how: Lite D1 now SMBJ22A C151920: its EasyEDA model (parts/easyeda/C151920.json) has the same SMB_L4.6-W3.6-LS5.3-RD pads as C364296 with pin 1 = K, so the footprint, the cathode-bar silk and pad 1 on VBUS are unchanged. Core D1 SMBJ30A, D2/D4 BZT52C33/C15 as before (MDD SMBJ30A p1, BORN BZT52Cxx p1).

dfm:7.how: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B (gct.co/files/drawings/usb4085.pdf, fetched 2026-10-30) sheet 2 against core.kicad_pcb J1, pad by pad: A row A1 A4..A9 A12 and B row B12 B9..B4 B1 (B12 under A1) 1.35 apart at 0.85 pitch, within 0.005 mm of the drawing; shell slots 0.6x2.1 / 0.6x1.4 in 0.9x2.4 / 0.9x1.7 at +-4.325, the long pair 0.98 from the A row and the short pair 3.38 behind it; the board edge (x 34.587) sits exactly 1.74 mm from the short pair's centres (x 36.327), as drawn. Only the pads differ, 0.70 for 0.65, on purpose (DFM-6).

power:26.how: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B (gct.co/files/drawings/usb4085.pdf, fetched 2026-10-30) sheet 1: 48 V DC, 5.00 A collectively for the VBUS pins, 6.25 A for GND, 1.25 A for A5/B5, 240 W. At 28 V / 5 A: 42 % voltage margin, 0 % current margin at the full 5 A PD contract (the governor holds about 1.1 A average).

digital:30.how: boards/ultra-front/README.md: the panel carries one TCA9535 (0x27) for the knob, buttons, LCD reset and RGB LED, its own IR receiver on IR_OUT (10 k pull-up there), INT open-drain with a 10 k pull-up there, ENC_A/B with 10 k + 10 nF; I2C pull-ups are on the core.

digital:36.how: boards/ultra-front/README.md: one I2C device on the panel (TCA9535 at 0x27), no pull-ups there (the core's), over a 30-50 mm FFC: a few pF added to the bus.

digital:38.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000262/263 Rev.1 (everlighteurope.com, fetched 2026-10-30) p1-2: operates at 2.4-5.5 V, recommended Vcc 3.0-5.5 V, TTL-compatible output (Vout max Vcc+0.3), so at OPT_VCC = 3.3 V the output swings to 3.3 V into the ES9018K2M GPIO; 10 % margin at the 3.0 V floor.
